purpose: Open raw-evidence pull requests in grandchallenge/MATHSOLVE for already-created and validated controlled-epistemic-interface intake evidence branches. Registered profiles are NS-CI-001, UC-001/WP08-D004, and ERDOS-OPEN-RECON. OPENMATH ownership remains with MP-OPENMATH-UNATTENDED-LIFECYCLE-001.
authority_source: existing GCL Release Trust GitHub App installation; short-lived per-run token only
allowed_actions: read protected MATHSOLVE dispatch records for explicitly registered CEI profiles
read already-created registered intake evidence branches
validate each branch against its campaign-specific dispatch and receipt schema
compare intake branch to protected main
open a pull request from an existing validated intake branch to main
prohibited_actions: create or alter intake evidence branches
claim certification or canonical mathematical effect
use administration, actions-write, checks-write, or workflow-write authority
validation_requirements: branch maps exactly to an explicitly registered campaign dispatch identifier
branch diff is exactly one raw result and one receipt for the same comment id
receipt binds the protected dispatch, issue, bootstrap, handoff, and raw artifact identity required by that campaign profile
receipt is schema-valid for the registered profile, current-for-dispatch, received_unadjudicated, and canonical_claim_effect=false
no raw result for the dispatch is already present on protected main
no open intake PR already exists for the branch
